mission: Mission 3DG - PopSign fresh5 scaffold feature-collapse packet

head.subject: observer: CONTINUE - popsign fresh5 scaffold feature handoff

changed_files.change_summary: Extends the existing inference-only feature helper to read scaffold forward_with_diagnostics feature spaces and rank/covariance descriptors.
Records the M3DG no-training scaffold feature-collapse packet.
Numbered executor session log for the M3DG feature-collapse slice.

artifacts_inspected.role: Existing M3DD scaffold checkpoint loaded read-only
M3CU late-fusion train split feature separability receipt
Scoped inference-only feature helper updated for scaffold diagnostics
Model architecture/diagnostic feature code inspected/read-only imported

helper_compatibility_patch.reason: The prior helper only hooked model.head[0], which is compatible with the late-fusion TCN path but not with the M3DD scaffold. The patch preserves that hook path and adds scaffold forward_with_diagnostics feature capture for existing tensors only.

feature_capture.post_norm_head_input: post_norm_head_input from forward_with_diagnostics and input to model.classifier

inference_only_feature_extraction.nearest_centroid_diagnostic_type: descriptive distances from frozen features only; no learned weights, optimization, threshold tuning, or classifier fitting

representation_localization_summary.localization_readout: Every train feature space has between-label centroid mean below within-label centroid mean and descriptive nearest-centroid accuracy near chance. The post-norm classifier input is very low-variance and nonseparable before the final classifier.

added_by_m3dg: Scaffold feature collapse is visible before the final classifier at post_norm_head_input.
Pooled pre-head and post-LayerNorm features are near-constant by variance/covariance trace and nonseparable by nearest-centroid diagnostics.
Earlier token spaces retain more absolute variance but still have between-label centroids closer than within-label spread.

m3cv_classification.strongest_current_explanation: The M3CR checkpoint has representation collapse before the classifier head: fused head-input features already show near-chance descriptive nearest-centroid accuracy and between-label centroids closer than within-label variation. LayerNorm/readout compresses absolute feature scale further but does not create the collapse alone.

m3cu_m3cv_comparison.conclusion: The scaffold reproduces the same qualitative representation-collapse pattern as M3CU/M3CV: near-chance descriptive nearest-centroid behavior, between-label centroids closer than within-label spread, and low-variance classifier-input representations before the final classifier.

current_strongest_explanation.rationale: The post_norm_head_input train feature space has mean variance 3.3134213325565313e-7, covariance trace 0.00004241179340169765, between/within ratio 0.352565828783245, and leave-one-out nearest-centroid accuracy 0.216 while logits remain single-class collapsed. Earlier scaffold feature spaces show more absolute variance but still do not retain usable label structure.

decision.rationale: The scaffold collapse is already present in frozen representation spaces before the classifier, and the final classifier/input boundary does not retain enough label structure to justify a last-layer-only packet. The next smallest useful step is a no-training scaffold architecture/data generalization packet before any architecture/input change, training, Brev, product downscope, STOP, or strategy escalation.

negative_authorizations_and_proof.proof: Only repo audits, JSON parsing, py_compile, a scoped helper compatibility patch, read-only checkpoint forward-pass feature extraction, and tracked receipt/session-log writes were performed. The M3DG diagnostic output is under ignored output/ and no claim surface changed.

commands_intentionally_not_run: browser activation or model promotion command
